about: Default clip set, by Mixamo file hash in the jasongzy/Mixamo mirror. Each was chosen by motion and posture features (blender/scan_mixamo.py, blender/scan_posture.py) and checked to loop cleanly in the source (blender/loop_quality.py: walk and run both close with a 0.00x seam). Replace any entry with your own Mixamo download to change the character's moves.
